description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Data utilities] Runs a JavaScript (ECMAScript) regular expression on your text and returns every match with index, line, column, numbered and named groups, or the result of replace or split. Catastrophic patterns are stopped after 3 seconds and not charged. Input: pattern (or /pattern/flags), text, optional flags, mode, replace, max_matches (POST for long text). Limits: 2,000-character pattern, 400,000-character text. Offline.

flags.description: Regex flags, e.g. gi (or write the pattern as /.../flags)

mode.description: match (all matches with groups, default), test (first match only), replace or split

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression, up to 2,000 characters, either the bare pattern or /pattern/flags

replace.description: Replacement for mode=replace ($1, $<name>, $&; default empty = delete matches)

text.description: Text to run the regex on, up to 400,000 characters (POST for long text)

trial.description: Optional. true = answer free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day); otherwise you get the payment terms.

name: regex_test

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: Regex tester: matches, groups, replace and split (JavaScript flavor) ($0.002/call)
